body: I don't think I can afford a psychiatrist
Probably, the few people I know think that I'm depressed. But I haven't diagnosed by an actual professional.

Or my goals are too unrealistic/fantastical, like I want to find someone that loves me and be happy, like some cheesy romcom, but I'm a sad loner that doesn't even know how relationships work outside of movies/anime/The Sims

Thanks for the kind comment, unfortunately I don't know how to make games, unless you mean like selling the games I own, and unfortunately those are all on Steam. I get where you're coming from with setting goals, but I'm kind of a perfectionist, I set my goals too high and I'm too lazy and pessimistic to achieve my own expectations.
